name: Escape Path
storyline:
While most of Plaenala's inhabitants live in harmony with nature, one folk, the Genoexas, seek to exploit it down to its last resource and wish to rule the entire planet. To protect themselves, the Genonalas build mazes that only they can solve and hide a crystal beneath the Monebreu volcan.

Until the day the Genoexas manage to destroy the crystal... Navigate through complex mazes using your logic and avoiding enemies to rebuild the protective crystal and save Plaenala's fate!
summary: Navigate complex mazes using your logic and avoiding enemies to rebuild the protective crystal. A hand-drawn puzzle-game combining action and problem-solving, where every mistake can be fatal! Ready to take on the challenge and find the pieces before it's too late?
